notes.en: Offline 3D tools with local project management and restored project-first layout. CAD is a separate app. External updates, destructive cleanup and CAD download remain disabled. Android hardlink-fixture restrictions are reported honestly as UNSUPPORTED; other storage checks remain enforced. Back up projects before uninstalling or changing devices.
notes.zh: 离线三维工具与本地项目管理，恢复项目优先布局。CAD 为独立 App。外部更新、破坏性清理与 CAD 下载仍关闭。Android 硬链接样本限制如实显示为 UNSUPPORTED，其余存储检查继续执行。卸载或换机前请导出并验证项目备份。
